specializations.title: Backend Developer
specializations.summary: Builds the server side of applications: the business logic, APIs, databases and integrations that the user interface depends on. Responsible for making systems secure, reliable and able to scale under traffic.

specializations.title: Frontend Developer
specializations.summary: Builds the part of a website or web app that users see and interact with: layout, styling, interactivity and the integration of graphics and features. Works closely with designers and back-end developers, and is responsible for accessibility, performance and cross-browser compatibility.

specializations.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
specializations.summary: An AWS cloud engineer designs, deploys and operates workloads on Amazon Web Services. The role balances cost, performance, security and reliability, following the Well-Architected Framework, and keeps those workloads monitored, recoverable and secure once they are running.

specializations.title: DevOps Engineer
specializations.summary: A DevOps engineer bridges software development and operations so that teams can ship changes continuously and safely. The role builds and maintains the pipelines, infrastructure code, source-control practices and monitoring that turn a commit into a running, observable service.

specializations.title: Kubernetes Administrator
specializations.summary: A Kubernetes administrator installs, configures and operates Kubernetes clusters that run containerised workloads. The role covers cluster architecture and lifecycle, workload scheduling, services and networking, persistent storage, access control and, above all, troubleshooting clusters, nodes and applications.

specializations.title: Security Analyst
specializations.summary: A security analyst protects an organisation's systems and data by monitoring for threats, assessing risk and responding to incidents. The role manages access, firewalls and protection tools, documents security policy and procedures, and trains users to work securely.

specializations.title: Data Analyst
specializations.summary: A data analyst collects, cleans and explores data from databases, spreadsheets and APIs, then turns it into statistics, charts and reports that answer business questions. The work runs from descriptive analysis through hypothesis testing and regression to dashboards that let stakeholders make data-driven decisions.

specializations.title: Data Engineer
specializations.summary: A data engineer designs and builds the systems that collect, transform, store and serve data for analytics and applications. The role covers batch and streaming ingestion, pipelines and orchestration, warehouses and lakes, and keeping data workloads secure, monitored and reliable.

specializations.title: AI Application Developer
specializations.summary: An AI application developer builds products on top of model APIs such as Claude and OpenAI, using prompt engineering, tool use and structured outputs rather than training models. The role is about defining success criteria, iterating prompts against evaluations, and shipping reliable, safe, cost-aware features.

specializations.title: Machine Learning Engineer
specializations.summary: A machine learning engineer builds, trains, evaluates and productionizes ML models, turning prototypes into scalable, reusable systems. The role needs strong programming, ML and deep learning knowledge, data pipeline skills and familiarity with MLOps and generative AI.

specializations.title: Product Manager
specializations.summary: A product manager decides what a product should do and why, from market and user research through strategy, roadmap and launch. The role owns the product vision and backlog, works with engineering and design, and measures results with product metrics.

specializations.title: UX Designer
specializations.summary: Designs how a digital product works and feels for its users, grounded in research. Moves from understanding users' needs through wireframes and prototypes to tested, accessible interface designs, working closely with developers.

role.title: AI Application Developer
role.summary: An AI application developer builds products on top of model APIs such as Claude and OpenAI, using prompt engineering, tool use and structured outputs rather than training models.
